tasks.name: Question engine ACE skills
tasks.objective: Nine discoverable, validated question-engine skills with a shared standard, JSON Schema contracts, one deterministic checker for all four subjects, a skill validator and passing tests.

tasks.name: Curriculum catalog import (PNE2026-SUM-v1.0)
tasks.objective: SQLite five-table catalog and idempotent, verbatim workbook import with 98 objectives and 344 evidencias, practice-scope selection, rubric separation, no student data, and approved-baseline grounding rules (ADR-006).

tasks.name: T002.1 — PostgreSQL migration of the curriculum catalog
tasks.objective: Move the five-table catalog to PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL with idempotent, transactional, checksum-protected imports; 98 objectives, 344 evidencias, 78 selectable multiple-choice objectives; Docker Compose setup.
tasks.notes: Product Owner label T002.1. Tracker IDs must match ^T[0-9]{3}$, so the PO's next task 'T003' is tracked as T004.

tasks.name: T003 — Practice configuration UI and API
tasks.objective: FastAPI endpoints and plain HTML/CSS/JS page to configure practice (subject, one/several/all objectives, difficulty, 5/10/20/30 questions) with validated, deterministic, balanced allocation; no question generation.
tasks.notes: Product Owner label T003. Web interface confirmed available by the Product Owner (2026-10-21); automated browser check not executed (Edge cannot start under automation).

tasks.name: OpenRouter API integration
tasks.objective: OpenRouter connectivity with model discovery, configurable free-first routing, explicit paid fallback, timeouts, limited retries and usage capture (model, tokens, USD cost, latency); developer-only connectivity check; no question generation.
tasks.notes: Live connectivity test not run: OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured (.env missing).

tasks.name: First curriculum-grounded question
tasks.objective: Generate and validate one multiple-choice question per request from the PostgreSQL catalog via OpenRouter, with grounding, deterministic and math checks, blind solve, rubric, usage/cost records and a dev-only endpoint.
tasks.notes: Final: M02, C01, EL01, ES01 each accepted (checker 1.4.0, prompt 1.2.0); C09 rejects material key-length cues. $0.00 over 82 calls.

tasks.name: Validated practice set generation (PO T007, max 5 questions)
tasks.objective: Generate a practice set from a practice configuration with the existing allocation and single-question engine; linguistic clarity checks; in-set duplicate rejection; bounded retries; partial results on budget limits; sets, items and attempts persisted.
tasks.notes: Live set-d5c125f2 (M02, M04, M05; medium): complete 5/5, 8 requests, 31 calls, 15669/46124 tokens, $0.00, 1342 s. Checker 1.5.0 (L01-L03, M04 property selection).

tasks.name: Controlled parallel question generation (PO T008)
tasks.objective: Run practice-set slots with bounded concurrency (QUESTION_GENERATION_CONCURRENCY, default 2) with atomic budgets, set-wide duplicate detection, isolated slot histories and deterministic ordering; no validation changes.
tasks.notes: Live set-5b7eb9ee (M02, M04, M05): 5/5, 628 s vs 1342 s in T007 (-53%), 18 calls, 14172/40587 tokens, $0.00. Finding: select-based proof does not check property conditions (follow-up).

tasks.name: Mathematical validation correctness (PO T009)
tasks.objective: Deterministic math proofs count only when they establish what the question asks; property-based questions need an agreeing blind solve or are rejected.
tasks.notes: Checker 1.6.0. Of 18 accepted maths items, only the T008 slot 3 item newly loses its proof; no valid proof lost.

tasks.name: Student practice integration and real testing (PO T010)
tasks.objective: Server-managed generation jobs with polling, one-question-at-a-time practice, server-side evaluation, feedback and summary in the Spanish page; keys never sent before submission.
tasks.notes: Browser mocked 71/71; live run 1 partial 4/5 (truncation), run 2 complete 5/5 in 366 s, 22 calls, $0.00.

tasks.name: Reduce OpenRouter generation truncation (PO T011)
tasks.objective: Configurable generation output limit (default 6000), explicit truncation detection, comparison against 4000.
tasks.notes: Probe at 6000: truncation 7/19 (36.8%) vs 21/104 (20.2%) at 4000, p=0.14; median latency 61 s vs 39 s. No measured improvement.
